items.title: Bill Kirchner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2021
items.q: the last one is a concert at the New School in 2014 with Carlton Holmes on piano and Jim Ferguson is a great singer and bass player from Nashville and the late Holli Ross who was a wonderful singer who died a year or so ago of cancer

ctx.x: Now if a person, if a young woman calls you and says, “I’m getting married, I got your name, can you play” — and all the details. Is this something that you were required to go through the union to do?

No. I mean I worked, at the time there were these different club date offices that would just hire you and send you out to play with these ad hoc bands. Some of them were people that I worked with on a fairly steady basis and some of them were just one nighters, people I’d never seen before. But I would just go where I was told to go. But anyway, to answer the other part of your question, the best gigs I’ve ever done, I’m lucky in that several of them by serendipitously were recorded and have come out on CD. I…

I’m happy to hear that all the best gigs you mentioned were with your own arrangements and, you know, like sort of you being in charge. And I think that speaks well of your career also. A while back I watched a documentary on Quincy Jones. And you know I’ve been a fan, like most people, of the majority of his work and —
